organization: Illinois Department of Insurance / Pearson VUE

claim: Annual Illinois insurance producer exam attempt counts by line: Life Part 1 6,071 (70% pass); Accident/Health Part 1 3,986 (65%); Property Part 1 3,005 (55%); Casualty Part 1 3,143 (66%). Counts are exam attempts (include retakes), not unique candidates.

title: Become a Resident Producer
claim: Illinois requires 20 hours of pre-licensing education per major line of authority, 7.5 hours of which must be classroom; motor vehicle line 12.5 hours (5 classroom). Providers are certified and searchable via statebasedsystems.com.
excerpt: 20 hours per line of authority ... 7.5 of those hours must be completed in a classroom setting (paraphrase of page)
limitations: Page does not describe provider approval process or fees; 'classroom' may include live webinar per later rules - unverified.

title: State of Illinois Sexual Harassment Prevention Training Model
claim: Every Illinois employer must provide annual sexual harassment prevention training (Workplace Transparency Act, 775 ILCS 5/2-109); IDHR provides a free model program and free public virtual sessions; restaurants/bars need supplemental training (2-110).
excerpt: IDHR's model program is available online at no cost and meets requirements of Sections 2-109 and 2-110 (paraphrase)
limitations: Free state product directly commoditizes the paid market; page accessed via search summary.

title: BASSET (Beverage Alcohol Sellers and Servers Education and Training) program page
claim: ILCC is the licensing and regulatory authority for all seller/server training programs in Illinois and maintains a BASSET trainer directory. Since July 1, 2018 on-premise servers and ID checkers must complete BASSET (every 3 years, within 120 days of hire per provider pages).
excerpt: responsible beverage seller/server program ... designed to encourage profitable, responsible, and legal alcohol sales and service
limitations: Mandate details (2018 statewide, 3-year renewal, 120 days) come from provider pages in search results, not read on statute; provider license fee not found.

title: OSHA Outreach Training Program FAQ
claim: Outreach (10/30-hour card) trainers must complete OSHA #500/#501 trainer course, which requires five years of construction/general-industry safety experience (degree/CSP/CIH substitutes 2 years); authorization lasts 4 years; online classes only from OSHA-accepted independent online providers on a published list; fees not capped.
excerpt: OSHA does not issue waivers for [trainer course prerequisites] ... trainers are independent service providers ... fees may vary (paraphrase/short quote)
limitations: Page does not say whether new online providers are being accepted; online provider list is short (HSI, 360training/OSHAcampus, ClickSafety, UL/PureSafety, USF etc.).

organization: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation - Division of Real Estate
title: Real Estate Education Provider License Application (form 505-0767)
claim: Only DRE-licensed Education Providers may offer Illinois real estate pre-license, post-license or CE courses; fee $1,050 provider application plus $150 per course application; provider must be a registered entity and publish a single fee schedule charged to all students.
excerpt: An Education Provider application fee of $1,050 and a $150 fee for each course application ... All fees are non-refundable.
limitations: Does not give instructor licensing costs/time or renewal fees; course content approval timeline not stated.

title: Real Estate Review, Spring 2026
claim: Illinois broker licenses renew Feb–Apr 30, 2026 (two-year cycle) and brokers must complete CE or post-license education before renewal; PSI is the exam vendor; discipline often requires remedial courses.
excerpt: Renewal Window: February through April 30, 2026 ... Complete your continuing education ('CE') or post-license requirements before submitting your renewal.
limitations: No licensee counts or exam-candidate counts published in this issue.

title: FMCSA removes 10,000-plus driver training providers amid safety push
claim: FMCSA Training Provider Registry had ~16,000 providers listed when DOT began its review (late 2025); ~3,000 removed Dec 2025 and >10,000 removed since per an FMCSA official; registry crowded with low-quality ELDT providers.
excerpt: more than 10,000 providers have been removed from the training provider registry since December 2025 (as summarized in search results)
limitations: Trade press; publication date of the 10,000 figure not confirmed; figures conflict across dates (8,256 ELDT providers mid-2025 per another report). Same article as WS09-S020 (S008 records the search-summary figures, S020 the fetched quote).

title: Food Handler Training
claim: Illinois food handlers must complete ANSI-accredited training (restaurants) or an IDPH-approved/registered program (non-restaurants) within 30 days of hire and every 3 years; since 2018 managers need ANSI-accredited Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM) certification.
excerpt: food handler training must be ANSI accredited or an internal training program approved by IDPH (paraphrase)
limitations: 30-day/3-year detail from a county health department document; allergen-training details not read.

title: Informa buys B2B publisher Industry Dive
claim: Industry Dive (ad/marketing-services-funded free B2B trade newsletters) had 2021 revenue $81.9m and expected 2022 revenue ~$110m with EBITDA ~$34m (~31% margin, incumbent economics); Informa paid $389m cash (EV ~$525–530m incl. rollover/earn-outs), ~11x EBITDA.
excerpt: on track to earn around $110m ... in revenue in 2022 with ... EBITDA of $34m (as summarized)
limitations: Mature incumbent built over ~10+ years with ~30+ verticals; revenue mostly sponsored content/ads, not reader subscriptions. Not new-entrant economics.

title: Emerald Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2024 Financial Results
claim: US B2B trade-show operator Emerald: FY2024 revenue $398.8m (+4.2%), adjusted EBITDA $101.7m (~25% of revenue, incumbent economics; $100.2m ex insurance proceeds).
excerpt: Full year 2024 revenues were $398.8 million ... Adjusted EBITDA ... was $101.7 million for 2024
limitations: Large portfolio of mature shows; margin is analyst arithmetic; booth pricing/show-level economics not disclosed here.

title: Chegg Reports 2025 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Financial Results
claim: Generative AI / AI search threat to information products: Chegg FY2025 revenue $376.9m, down 39% YoY; Q4 revenue down 49%; company attributes reduced traffic/subscribers to changes in search interfaces (AI Overviews) and AI tools.
excerpt: Full-year 2025 revenue was $376.9 million, down 39% year over year (as summarized)

claim: Brokers licensed before Nov 1, 2023 need 12 CE hours per 2-year renewal (6-hr Core + 6 elective incl. Sexual Harassment Prevention); brokers first licensed Nov 2023–Oct 2025 need 45 hours post-license education; all through IDFPR-approved education providers.
excerpt: 12-hours of CE is required: This must consist of a 6-hour Core course and 6 hours of elective courses, including a Sexual Harassment Prevention Training.
limitations: No licensee counts; does not give price norms.
